remarks: Welcome to Heywood Heights, one of Stamford's most sought-after condo communities. This bright and inviting second floor unit offers two spacious bedrooms, one and a half bathrooms, and beautiful hardwood floors throughout. The open living and dining area is filled with natural light and features oversized sliders that lead to a large private balcony overlooking the well-kept grounds. The kitchen offers ample cabinet storage, granite counters, and a functional layout that opens nicely to the dining space. Both bedrooms are generously sized with great closet space, and the full bath is complemented by a convenient half bath for guests. Enjoy central air and an efficient heat-pump forced-air system for year round comfort, along with additional storage space located in the basement. The Heywood Heights community offers a serene setting with meticulously maintained landscaping, an in-ground pool for summer enjoyment, and ample parking. Truly a fantastic rental opportunity close to downtown Stamford, Metro-North, shopping, dining, and major commuter routes.
